title: Denial Review Periods: Appeal, Peer-to-Peer and Retroactive Windows for Referrals & Prior Authorizations
content:
The periods below apply to Referrals & Prior Authorizations decisions at Linden Ridge Medical Group and are set per referral type.

## Appeal periods

| Referral type | Appeal window (calendar days after the denial decision date) | Standard appeal decided within (calendar days) | Expedited appeal decided within (hours) | Appeal levels available | Patient's signed consent needed for an appeal filed by the group | Financial-liability notice when proceeding after a final denial |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | 30 | 10 | 24 | 1 | No | No |
| HMO Specialist Referral | 180 | 30 | 72 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Standing Specialist Referral | 180 | 30 | 72 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Out-of-Network Referral | 180 | 30 | 72 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | 180 | 30 | 72 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | 180 | 30 | 72 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | 180 | 30 | 72 | 2 | Yes | Yes |

## Peer-to-peer review and retroactive authorization

| Referral type | Peer-to-peer review available | Peer-to-peer request window (business days after the denial) | Peer-to-peer held within (business days) | Retroactive authorization window (calendar days after the date of service) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | No | 0 | 0 | 30 |
| HMO Specialist Referral | No | 0 | 0 | 0 (none) |
| Standing Specialist Referral | Yes | 10 | 2 | 0 (none) |
| Out-of-Network Referral | Yes | 10 | 2 | 0 (none) |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | Yes | 10 | 2 | 0 (none) |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | Yes | 5 | 1 | 14 |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | Yes | 5 | 1 | 7 |

## Notes on the figures

- **Appeal levels available** is the number of appeal levels before the denial is final.
- **Peer-to-peer review** is a review of a denial the ordering clinician may request with the payer; business days run Monday to Friday with group holidays excluded, and the turnaround is the business days within which the payer holds the review.
- **Retroactive authorization window**: 0 means no retroactive authorization may be requested for the type.
- The expedited appeal period is an elapsed-hour count; the other appeal periods are calendar days unless marked as business days.
